name: Europe hybrid attacks
value: GRU-ordered arson plot foiled, Estonia 14 Nov
summary: Estonia blamed Russia's GRU for a foiled 14 Nov arson attack on a drone maker; France blamed Iran's IRGC for store hacks
state: Estonia said Russian military intelligence ordered an attempted explosion and arson at drone maker Threod Systems on 14 Nov; eight Latvian citizens were detained and Estonia will close its road border with Russia from 1 Dec (Euromaidan Press; Kyiv Post). On 9–10 Nov France attributed October sabotage of refrigeration systems at about 700 stores to an IRGC-linked unit (Khaleej Times). No sabotage causing casualties or repeated multi-country shutdowns was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Follow police and national security service advice; report suspicious activity near infrastructure sites to local police.
rubric_hit: Sabotage attributed to a state (Russia, Iran) = Watch

sources.title: Euromaidan Press — Estonia to close all border crossings with Russia after GRU-ordered sabotage attempt
Khaleej Times — France accuses IRGC of cyberattack on supermarket fridges

why: Sabotage, arson and drone incursions over airports and bases are how state confrontation reaches daily life in the UK and Europe.
drivers: Russia–NATO tensions, drone and cyber capabilities, proxy recruitment, elections.

rubric.alert: Repeated airport or infrastructure shutdowns across several countries, or sabotage causing casualties or a major outage.
rubric.watch: Drone incursions close an airport or military base, or a sabotage incident is attributed to a state.
rubric.normal: No significant attributed sabotage or airspace incursions in Europe this week.
